notes.title: 🌕🧨 Lunar New Year 🎆🎉
notes.content:
The [b]Lunar New Year[/b] has arrived and with it the twin cats Luna Blue and Luna Red for you to puzzle.
We thought of very special cats for this occasion, the Maneki-neko (招き猫, beckoning cat).

During our research we found out that despite the fact that we associate these luck bringing cats with China, they originate in Japan and were adopted across Asia, even with the original text [b]10 mio ryo[/b].
So we went with the Maneki-neko as our newest cat, because it is so widely adopted across asia.

Since the the text is Japanese everywhere anyway, the amazing [url=https://www.twitch.tv/megumi_m]Megumi[/url] was so kind and translated JujiBla into Japanese, what means:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511437/2cfd07c8dae3e89a86da06cf80b83e10dff4bfab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511437/42449910ab9417968c17ec8d315d032f8c7363af.png[/img][/url]
樹    地    舞    螺
Ju    ji    bu    ra
tree earth dancing water snail

What you get with this free update:

[list]
[*] 🧩 1+1 new cats to puzzle
[*] 🖼️ 3 new backgrounds 
[*] 📱  4 new wallpapers to unlock
[*] 🎶 5 new music tracks
[/list]

Watch another totally wholesome lets play by the amazing [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCdD-OmzB4xWAvm7iir-U9Xg]AmberFrmThVault Gaming[/url] :ghsmile:
[previewyoutube=imS9wk15Tow;full][/previewyoutube]

Big thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/ToniHDS]ToniHDS[/url] for translating this update post to Chinese 💖.

We wish you a great time and a happy New Lunar Year 🌕🎉

- The SpielmannSpiel Team :ghsmile:

notes.title: ROTATION UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511437/de8c4470d0deb219948dacfea058ef6d812637ad.png[/img]

Releasing a game is always exciting!
Will you, the players actually like it?
Guess you do 💖, had a lot of feedback and we want to present you now the most wanted feature:

[h2]ROTATION[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511437/c62131900107f82df66fcecd29af34fb370f2b81.png[/img]

Puzzle pieces can now be rotated to increase the difficulty and give for a new challenge. It is totally optional to not make it too hard for those who want it more relaxing and has to be enabled in the settings.
We also enabled you to configure the piece snapping strength, to provide a even better challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511437/336f11c35f4db7003566782b6c2e67c11c03b332.png[/img]

There are also a lot of little bug fixes, improvements and the new [b]SHUFFLE [/b] pieces button in game.

Have fun puzzeling 💖

- the SpielmannSpiel Team
